requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline.
2+ years of experience as a software engineer for an autonomous robotics company.
2+ years of experience developing in Python in a Linux development environment.
Experience in either planning, mapping, or perception

The ideal candidate has a strong robotics software background with experience in planning and multi-robot coordination, thrives on rapidly integrating new platforms and technologies, and is excited to push the boundaries of what's useful with autonomy — transforming our best-in-class ground autonomy into an end-to-end mission capability solution.
Demonstrated work using terrain or mapping data to plan routes for autonomous vehicles.
Experience developing and using simulation tooling.
Working knowledge of robotics interface software such as ROS 2, MAVLink and
Experience with common military messaging protocols such as Cursor on Target (CoT) and TAK.
Experience working with robotic decision-making frameworks ranging from classical (behavior trees) to state-of-the-art (LLM-based).
Self-starter who is excited to define the art of possible in a rapidly evolving field.
This position may involve access to export-controlled technology. Employment is contingent on the ability to comply with U.S. export control laws.
